subject.title: fix(chat): preserve PNG attachments in native clients

question: Should native clients preserve every PNG as bounded PNG output, preserve only PNGs whose transparency would be lost, or retain the existing universal JPEG normalization policy?
rationale: The current JPEG behavior was deliberately introduced and tested as the transport, privacy, and payload policy; source inspection cannot determine whether changing that shipped product contract is intended.

options.title: Preserve bounded PNGs
options.body: Approve the PR's cross-platform policy, then require real Android or Apple gateway-send proof for transparent and oversized PNG inputs.

options.title: Preserve alpha only
options.body: Keep opaque PNGs on the established JPEG path while retaining PNG only when conversion would discard meaningful transparency.

options.title: Keep JPEG normalization
options.body: Retain the current size-oriented format policy and close or re-scope this PR to another explicitly approved behavior.

recommendation.title: Preserve bounded PNGs
recommendation.body: Approve the PR's cross-platform policy, then require real Android or Apple gateway-send proof for transparent and oversized PNG inputs.

likelyOwner.reason: They introduced the current Apple attachment-processing contract and are the strongest available feature-history owner for evaluating the proposed policy change.
